description: This source file implements the XBSStore class, which manages bootstrap configuration data, including reading/writing configuration files, monitoring partner ID changes via inotify, and handling device-specific defaults. It also includes functions for creating necessary files and directories, and for updating internal cache and external files based on JSON configuration and partner ID changes.
